historyHelp.title: Momwe Mungachotsere Mbiri Yanu Yosakatula Mosamala
historyHelp.chromeInstructions: Tsegulani Menu (⋮) → History → Clear browsing data → sankhani "History" ndi "Cookies" → Clear data.
historyHelp.safariInstructions: Tsegulani pulogalamu ya Settings → Safari → Clear History and Website Data.
historyHelp.safetyNote: Izi zimachotsa mbiri yosakatula pa chipangizo chanu, koma sizichotsa zolemba zomwe zimasungidwa ndi kampani yanu ya foni kapena wopereka Wi-Fi. Ngati kuli kotetezeka, gwiritsani ntchito foni ya mnzanu kapena kompyuta ya laibulale ya anthu onse.
